statement: Let \(a \geq 1\) be a real number. Put \(x_1 = a\) and \(x_{n+1} = 1 + \ln\!\left(\dfrac{x_n^2}{1 + \ln x_n}\right)\) for \(n = 1, 2, \ldots\) Prove that the sequence \(\{x_n\}\) converges and find its limit.

Given a tetrahedron \(ABCD\) with circumcenter \(O\). Draw diameters \(AA_1, BB_1, CC_1, DD_1\) of the circumsphere. Let \(A_0, B_0, C_0, D_0\) be the centroids of triangles \(BCD, CDA, DAB, ABC\) respectively. Prove that \(A_0A_1, B_0B_1, C_0C_1, D_0D_1\) are concurrent at a point \(F\). Prove also that the line through \(F\) and any midpoint of a side of \(ABCD\) is perpendicular to the opposite side.

The sequence \(\{a_n\}_{n \geq 0}\) is defined by \(a_0 = 20\), \(a_1 = 100\), and \(a_{n+2} = 4a_{n+1} + 5a_n + 20\) for \(n = 0, 1, 2, \ldots\) Find the smallest positive integer \(h\) such that \(1998 \mid a_{n+h} - a_n\) for all \(n = 0, 1, 2, \ldots\)

Does there exist an infinite sequence \(\{x_n\}\) of reals satisfying:
i) \(|x_n| \leq 0.666\) for all \(n = 1, 2, \ldots\)
ii) \(|x_m - x_n| \geq \dfrac{1}{n(n+1)} + \dfrac{1}{m(m+1)}\) for all \(m \neq n\)?

Find the minimum value of
\[F(x,y) = \sqrt{(x+1)^2+(y-1)^2} + \sqrt{(x-1)^2+(y+1)^2} + \sqrt{(x+2)^2+(y+2)^2}\]
where \(x, y \in \mathbb{R}\).
Find all positive integers \(n\) such that there exists \(P \in \mathbb{R}[x]\) satisfying \(P(x^{1998} - x^{-1998}) = x^n - x^{-n}\) for all \(x \in \mathbb{R} \setminus \{0\}\).
